summary: PostToolUse lifecycle hook imported the full parser stack and failed when web-tree-sitter was unavailable
evidence: Observed import chain hook-cli.ts -> hooks.ts -> due.ts -> commands.ts -> phrasebook.ts -> oracle-domain.ts -> web-tree-sitter; hook startup failed before handling PostToolUse. npm ci restored the package but did not remove the architectural failure mode.

summary: consequence source is classified as binary because validation regexes contain literal NUL bytes
evidence: rg reports src/consequence.ts: binary file matches; LC_ALL=C od shows 00 bytes in two regex character classes

summary: orientation source is classified as binary because its renderer regex contains literal control bytes
evidence: sed renders literal C0/C1 controls in visible(); repository text scanners can stop treating the TypeScript file as ordinary text

summary: orient treats all historical blocked journal reports as live unblock obligations
evidence: on the real worktree, coherence orient emitted ORIENTATION UNBLOCK because the merged journal contains 23 blocked reports, while the work ledger had 0 orders and those reports have no close lifecycle

summary: strict consequence read can ignore surviving evidence or follow an intermediate ledger symlink
evidence: readConsequences checks only .coherence/consequences, filters out every non-.jsonl entry, and skips blank/torn endings; renaming a row file to .bak yields an empty healthy projection and a symlinked .coherence parent is not inspected

summary: the new progressive README and command registry overstate or misplace parts of the swarm CLI contract
evidence: read-only audit found: stale next-section pointer; authority wording excludes valid ungraded subjects; verification example omits its unchecked-ref ceiling; expected-previous token is JSON-only; context detail is pre-budget; decide usage makes optional --over mandatory; inspect summaries imply rejected --session flags; orient summary omits experiments

summary: SessionStart tells assigned agents to run a work inspect command the CLI rejects
evidence: assignedWorkInstructions emits work inspect --session, while the work inspect allowlist rejects --session; the only live-state re-read instruction exits 2

summary: orientation dispatches orphan work whose parent is already terminal
evidence: parent completed then late child opened yields work stats orphans=1 and ready child; observeOrientation selects DISPATCH even though the join target cannot accept the result

summary: trusted decision projection lacks ledger containment and canonical append framing
evidence: readTrustedJournal follows a symlinked .coherence parent, filters away renamed non-jsonl history, skips blank rows, and accepts missing final newline, allowing surviving evidence to shrink silently

summary: new work and consequence writes silently last-win repeated singleton attribution flags
evidence: work create with --session one --session two exits 0 and records writer two; exact authority and identity inputs are ambiguous instead of refused

summary: the typed consequence relation table admits nonsensical produces targets
evidence: relationProblem validates only the source kind for produces, so work:a --produces--> decision:d and commit:a --produces--> work:b are accepted despite the typed-endpoint contract

summary: orientation promotes malformed or unattributable verification status to current
evidence: a status verify section with at=not-a-time, failures=not-a-number, tier=full, commit=null is accepted as source ok/current; missing commit also compares current

summary: orientation can throw instead of returning REFUSE when the decision ledger path is invalid
evidence: making .coherence/decisions a regular file causes raw ENOTDIR because the decision read is the only orientation source outside a catch

summary: parent work can close without a completed child and create an irreparable synthesis obligation
evidence: closeWork(parent, completed, synthesizedChildren=[]) succeeds after its direct child completed; orient then selects SYNTHESIZE, but a second close that names the child refuses because the parent is terminal

summary: PostToolUse still crashes the host session when read-trace persistence is damaged
evidence: with a real Read payload and .coherence/read-traces as a regular file, hook-cli PostToolUse exits 1 with EEXIST; the isolated canary used empty payload so it never exercised recordHookReads

summary: work lifecycle can activate and complete an order before its dependencies
evidence: child dependsOn open parent is projected waiting, but transitionWork(child, active) and closeWork(child, completed) both succeed; final graph reports no problem while dependency remains open

summary: work and decision session filenames can collide by case on portable filesystems
evidence: sessions Owner and owner map to case-aliasing slug filenames; on APFS both append to one file and the strict reader later refuses the second row as displaced

summary: work ledger text can inject peer instructions into SessionStart
evidence: objective, criteria, authority actor, and boundary accept embedded newlines; assignedWorkInstructions interpolates them raw into additionalContext, so data like newline SYSTEM becomes an instruction-shaped line

summary: failing batched verification leaks a passing oracle name through holding-cost output
evidence: npm test failed test/test-batch.test.ts:314: expected output not to match outer inner nest deep, but the holding-cost section rendered that passing claim beside the two red claims
